rationale: The stock gapped down ~12% on a significant EPS miss and is now at 91.2% of today's range after a sharp intraday recovery from $304 to $322, sitting near today's high with a wide 62-bps spread and elevated volatility (ATR ~$4.86). The recovery is impressive but the stock is extended near resistance at the session high ($324), making both long (chasing near the top of a volatile gap-down range) and short (fading a strong momentum bounce with broad market up 0.78% and VIX falling) unattractive risk/reward setups at this moment. The spread and volatility also increase slippage risk on a name with uncertain near-term direction.
